assignments_list_empty_instructor: This course has no assignments. Create one in {folder} and run {command}.
assignments_delivery_pinned_note: Pinned: pushes after the due date do not replace it.
assignments_delivery_late_note: Shown to the instructor as a separate delivery.
assignments_delivery_none_text: No push reached main before the due date.
assignments_delivery_note_team: New pushes to main until {due} update the team's delivery.
assignments_delivery_note_own: New pushes to main until {due} update your delivery.
assignments_pending_text: Make the first push to main by {when} ({relative}).
assignments_alert_due_passed_until: The due date has passed. Pushes are still accepted until {closes}, but they count as a late delivery.
assignments_alert_due_passed_open: The due date has passed. Pushes are still accepted until the instructor closes them, but they count as a late delivery.
assignments_alert_closed: Pushes closed on {when}. Cloning is still available.
assignments_incomplete_open: Incomplete team: the minimum is {min} members and there are {count}. You can already push, but ask your teammates to join with the code until {lock}.
assignments_incomplete_locked: Incomplete team: the minimum is {min} members and there are {count}. Ask your instructor if the team should change.
assignments_missing_note: The push is not blocked, but the delivery may lose points without them.
assignments_first_push_scratch: Starting from scratch: clone, work and push.
assignments_first_push_existing: Already have a project on your machine:
assignments_first_push_rules: The server only accepts the main branch, with no force-push. The moment of each push is the server's.
assignments_rotate_note: The current URL stops working. Change your remote with {command}.
assignments_leave_last: You are the last member and the team already has pushes. Only the instructor can undo this.
assignments_leave_locked: Teams locked on {when}. Only the instructor changes the composition.
assignments_clone_note: This URL is yours alone and carries push permission: do not share it. Only the main branch is accepted; a push to another branch is refused.
assignments_clone_note_closed: This URL is yours alone and carries push permission: do not share it. Pushes are closed, but cloning is still available.
assignments_individual_text: This assignment is individual. The server creates a repository just for you, and what is on main by the due date is your delivery.
assignments_locked_individual: The time to create the repository ended on {when}. Ask your instructor.
assignments_locked_team: Teams locked on {when} and you are in none. Ask your instructor to be put in a team.
assignments_team_intro: Teams of {min} to {max} members. Create yours or join one with the code a classmate gives you, until {when}.
assignments_cli_status_teams: Teams, members, on-time and late delivery of each.
assignments_cli_status_individual: Students, on-time and late delivery of each.
assignments_cli_clone_teams: Clones each team into submissions/, at the on-time delivery commit. Use --late for the late delivery.
assignments_cli_clone_individual: Clones each repository into submissions/, at the on-time delivery commit. Use --late for the late delivery.

match.countPlural=one: No members. The repository and {count} push stay stored
match.countPlural=other: No members. The repository and {count} pushes stay stored

assignments_unassigned_empty: Every enrolled student is in a team.
assignments_dialog_create_hint: The team starts empty: add the students afterwards, from the table.
assignments_dialog_add_exception: {members}. The assignment asks for {min} to {max}; adding here makes an exception.
assignments_dialog_add_type: Type part of the name or username.
assignments_dialog_move_token: Their token changes: the old clone URL stops working.
assignments_dialog_move_pushes: What they pushed stays in the repository of the team they leave.
assignments_dialog_move_new: They now push to the repository of the new team.

match.countPlural=one: The team's repository and the {count} push will be lost. This cannot be undone.
match.countPlural=other: The team's repository and the {count} pushes will be lost. This cannot be undone.
